items.title: Tim Kelly Interview, 1979-03-26
items.q: He was the pianist in the group that we used in Lake Charles. And he was an original pianist with the Buddies Blue Melody Boys. It was a band that I played with for about three years.

ctx.x: I'm coming out with Brooks and Dick and getting Bigs. Yeah. But who were they?

Well, now, Brooks Pruitt was a really wonderful pianist. And Brooks was from Laurel, Mississippi instead. But he came over into Arkansas when I first met him. And he played outstanding piano. He played with the Buddies Blue Melody Boys. He was the pianist in the group that we used in Lake Charles. And he was an original pianist with the Buddies Blue Melody Boys. It was a band that I played with for about three years. And Pruitt wasn't always the pianist. He was the first pianist. But he was a very interesting…
No, they say he was a real character. Yeah.
